name: Sterling Wire Products
old_description: is committed to providing you with quality wire products, delivered on-time with special attention to your unique requirements.
about:
Sterling Wire Products, Inc. operates from Rock Falls, Illinois. For nearly 50 years, the company has focused on reliable shaped wire solutions, building a reputation for on-time delivery and attention to unique customer requirements.

The company manufactures shaped wire and straightened-and-cut wire in forms that include flat, rectangular, rolled round edge, square, and custom-edged profiles. It offers annealing to spring temper for springs, clips, rings, and hardware, and produces custom shapes such as half rounds, keystones, specified corner radii, and knurling. Materials range from aluminum to specialty alloys such as Preco Z, with products supplied as coils, spools, or straightened and cut lengths. The shop also accepts prototype orders that other suppliers may decline.

Sterling Wire Products serves customers ranging from global corporations to small shops that need custom specifications. Its wire products find use in applications such as springs, clips, rings, and hardware across various industrial sectors.

The company emphasizes domestic production — marked "SHAPED IN THE U.S.A." — and differentiates itself through short lead times, responsive service, and a willingness to handle prototype runs that others cannot or will not accommodate.

name: Stoba USA Corporation
old_description: stoba – Technologiepartner für die Entwicklung, Produktion und Montage von Präzisionskomponenten und -systemen
about:
Stoba USA Corporation is based in Charleston, South Carolina, and operates as the U.S. entity of the global Stoba Group, a German-headquartered technology partner for precision components and systems. The founding year of the U.S. subsidiary is not publicly disclosed; the parent company traces its roots to decades of experience in precision engineering and special machine building. Ownership details for the U.S. entity are not specified in available sources.

The company develops, produces, and assembles high-precision metal components and hybrid systems, covering processes such as milling, drilling, hard and fine machining, laser processing, electrochemical machining (ECM/PECM), turning, sheet metal fabrication, cleaning, measuring and testing, and final assembly. Stoba also designs and builds custom tooling, fixtures, and production equipment to realize complex parts. The group serves prototype through large-series volumes across its facilities in Germany, China, and the United States, supported by in-house engineering for software, hardware, and mechanics.

Stoba’s customer base spans commercial vehicles, semiconductors, agricultural and construction machinery, maritime, passenger cars, e-mobility, micro-mobility, consumer goods, industrial applications, aerospace, security and defense, and medical and laboratory sectors. The company emphasizes simultaneous engineering to industrialize challenging components that conventional methods cannot address.

Stoba differentiates itself through interdisciplinary expertise combining precision technology and special machine building, a focus on innovation and process development, and a global service network offering worldwide support from development through series production.

name: Stout's Metal Products
old_description: Stout’s Metal delivers precision designed metal fabrications that are built to last.
about:
Stout's Metal Products operates from Collingswood, New Jersey, where it was officially established in 1985 by Larry Stout and his wife Julianne. The business traces its roots to the 1960s when Larry's father, Ken Stout, a former Navy Yard shipbuilder, opened an ornamental metal shop in Atco. In 1984 the couple purchased a 300‑year‑old property with a rear workspace that had served as an 1880s ice house, a trailer storage shed, and a chicken coop, converting it into their fabrication shop.

The company provides custom metal fabrication and welding services, producing railings and balcony systems (steel, aluminum, wrought iron), ornamental and security fences and gates, ADA‑compliant safety railings, window security bars, and custom metal furniture, truck racks, dock ramps, Bilco doors, and artistic metalwork. They also offer on‑site and mobile welding for structural steel modification, equipment repair, and emergency fixes. The shop serves residential, commercial, and trade clients across South Jersey, eastern Pennsylvania, and the Jersey Shore, with over 8,000 projects completed.

Customers include homeowners, contractors, business owners, and property managers. Notable projects include railings for the Scottish Rite Auditorium, steel piping for the Battleship New Jersey dock in Camden, and a custom iron gate for former Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter. The firm's work has been featured in the local Courier Post newspaper.

The Stouts emphasize understanding each client's needs, maintaining clear communication and schedules, and delivering work to the highest standard every time. They describe their motivation as carrying on a family passion, preserving the art of ornamental metalwork, and creating quality pieces that last for generations.

about:
Stradabella Food Trucks is based in Phoenix, Arizona, where it designs and builds custom mobile kitchens. The company operates under the name Stradabella Custom Mobile Kitchens and offers a design-to-delivery service for food trucks, trailers, carts, and kiosks.

The firm’s core capability is the end-to-end fabrication of mobile food units. Its craftsmen customize vehicles of all sizes and styles, managing the process from initial design through final delivery. The company advertises that it can build trucks for customers anywhere in the world, providing nationwide service.

Stradabella’s customer base consists primarily of food-service entrepreneurs and mobile-vending operators seeking a purpose-built kitchen on wheels. The company does not publicly list specific industry sectors but positions its products as solutions for anyone launching a mobile food business.

The company states that its expert craftsmen and focus on quality set it apart, describing itself as a go-to source for the highest-quality food trucks, trailers, carts, and kiosks.

name: Stratford Steel
old_description: We have worked with Stratford Steel Fabrication since 2017 on approximately 7 historical restoration projects and they have been great to work with.
about:
Stratford Steel Fabrication operates from Stratford, Connecticut. The company was founded in 2017, according to directory records, and draws on over 150 years of collective industry experience among its team. Ownership structure and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom ornamental metalwork, producing stairs, railings, canopies, and restoration components in steel, brass, aluminum, and stainless steel. All work — estimating, drafting, engineering, project management, fabrication, finishing, and installation — is performed in-house. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

The firm serves architects, conservation and restoration firms, general contractors, and developers across the Tri-State area. Notable projects include a brass spiral staircase for a Gramercy penthouse, canopy fabrication for the Walker Hotel, restoration of 100-year-old railings at the Knickerbocker Club, stainless steel replacement parts for the Marcus Garvey Watchtower, a cantilevered stair in East Hampton, and a poolhouse canopy in Greenwich. Clients such as Jan Hird Pokorny Associates, Highline Construction Group, Legere Group, and trueEX Group have cited the company's turn-key capability and responsiveness.

Stratford Steel states its mission is to “remove the barriers and headaches from your ornamental steel projects” through a design-thinking approach that encourages creative freedom. The company emphasizes in-house control from concept to installation as its primary differentiator.

name: Stride Manufacturing
old_description: We partner with brands to design, develop, and deliver fully custom apparel at scale.
about:
Stride Manufacturing operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, as a full-service apparel and merchandise partner. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The firm manages the entire apparel lifecycle: concept and strategy, artwork and design, sampling and prototyping, approvals and compliance, and manufacturing through a vetted network of factory partners that handle cut-and-sew, embroidery, and embellishments. It also oversees logistics and fulfillment, including packaging, warehousing, and direct-to-consumer delivery. Production scale ranges from roughly one hundred pieces to tens of thousands per order.

Stride serves brands and businesses launching new labels, scaling streetwear lines, or developing private-label merchandise. Its customer base includes retailers, e-commerce operators, and companies seeking custom apparel programs. The company cites work with streetwear labels and corporate merch programs as typical engagements.

Stride emphasizes a 'no middlemen' model, an in-house creative team, and a global network of trusted, ethical factories. It highlights transparent communication, end-to-end logistics, and direct-to-consumer dropshipping as differentiators. The company has been recognized with awards such as Emerging Apparel Manufacturer (2023) and Top Product Development Firm (2024).

name: Stuffed Foods LLC
old_description: At Stuffed Foods, we know that our products are only as good as
about:
Stuffed Foods LLC operates from Wilmington, Massachusetts. The company was formed when its management team, drawing on more than 60 years of combined experience in artisan foods, recognized growing demand for scratch-quality shareable appetizers such as meatballs and arancini and launched the business to serve that niche.

The company produces a line of frozen food products including ravioli, veggie burgers, poppers, mac and cheese, arancini, empanadas, and arepas. Production relies on small-batch preparation and scratch-cooking techniques using traditional methods that preserve fresh-ingredient quality. The USDA- and FDA-inspected facility in Wilmington operates under a HACCP plan and undergoes annual audits by Silliker Laboratories.

Stuffed Foods sells primarily into foodservice channels, supplying distributors, restaurants, caterers, and hotels. Its products are also carried by retail grocery outlets.

Management says the business was started to meet demand for scratch-quality appetizers made with fresh, bold ingredients. The company differentiates itself through small-batch production, traditional cooking methods, and a food-safety program that includes USDA/FDA approval, HACCP compliance, and third-party audits.

name: Sturges Electronics LLC
old_description: 'Build to print' custom wire and cable harness manufacturer for defense/medical/industrial
about:
Sturges Electronics LLC was founded in 1978 in Dryden, New York, as a woman-owned small business specializing in custom wire and cable harness assemblies. The company has operated continuously from its upstate New York location for over four decades.

The company provides custom "build to print" wire and cable harnesses ranging from simple two-circuit assemblies to complex designs with 50 or more circuits, using wire gauges from 30 AWG to 2 AWG. Its capabilities combine automated processes on a Schleuniger wire cutting, stripping, and crimping machine with semi-automated TE and Molex crimp presses, micro soldering under microscope, RF cable assembly, and IPC Class 2 and 3 testing for continuity, insulation resistance, and dielectric withstanding voltage. Sturges handles prototype and first-article builds as well as production runs from one or two units up to thousands, and offers box build assembly and overmolded cables through subcontract partners.

Sturges serves the industrial, defense, medical, transportation, and military markets, delivering harnesses for applications in those sectors. The company's customer base includes military and defense contractors, medical device manufacturers, and transportation equipment builders.

Sturges differentiates itself through its ISO 9001:2015 certification, IPC/WHMA-A-620 specialist certified inspectors, ITAR registration, and cybersecurity compliance, all within a woman-owned small business structure that emphasizes responsive service for both prototype and high-volume orders.
